presets.name: Vivid
presets.author: Glint
presets.about: Richer colour with a touch more contrast. A good first preset to try.

presets.name: Competitive clarity
presets.author: Glint
presets.about: Punchier colour, firmer contrast and slightly lifted mid-tones for spotting players.

presets.name: Night vision
presets.author: Glint
presets.about: Lifts dark areas so you can see into shadows and night scenes.

presets.name: Cinematic
presets.author: Glint
presets.about: Deeper contrast and slightly muted colour for story games.

presets.name: Soft evening
presets.author: Glint
presets.about: A warmer, slightly dimmer screen for late-night browsing.
